## 4. Supported roles and institute scope

**P:** Use a discriminated server role resolver: SUPER_USER, ADMIN, INSTRUCTOR (DB aliases PROFESSOR/TEACHER/INSTRUCTOR), STUDENT, and an unauthorized UNKNOWN result. Only exact supported role strings after consistent case normalization count; caller headers/body claims never participate. SUPER_USER receives only `academic-oversight:read` / `course-supervision:read` capabilities. These capabilities do not feed the legacy administration permission matrix. requireAdmin remains ADMIN-only. requirePermission must refuse SUPER_USER legacy permissions regardless of persisted JSON.

| Actor | Dedicated oversight APIs/pages | Existing feature rights |

| Active SUPER_USER | List/detail in explicitly selected ICS/IBE/ITE | Deny administration, teaching, grading, enrollment, submission, assessment and execution privileges even if assigned/enrolled/owner. |
| ADMIN | 403 from dedicated APIs (F); page denied (P) | Preserve administration and existing authorized course reads/actions. |

| Enrolled STUDENT | 403 from dedicated APIs (F) | Preserve approved-enrollment course access and owned work. |

| Missing/invalid/expired/inactive session | 401 dedicated APIs (inactive/missing explicitly F) | No protected data; existing inactive-session cleanup may occur. |

prisma/schema.prisma.content:
generator client {
  provider      = "prisma-client-js"
  binaryTargets = ["native", "rhel-openssl-1.0.x", "rhel-openssl-3.0.x", "debian-openssl-3.0.x", "linux-musl-openssl-3.0.x"]
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
}

model Institute {
  id             String          @id @default(cuid())
  code           String          @unique
  name           String
  createdAt      DateTime        @default(now())
  calendarEvents CalendarEvent[]
  courses        Course[]
  flashcardDecks FlashcardDeck[]
  notes          Note[]
  taskItems      TaskItem[]
  users          User[]
  kxPosts        KxPost[]
}

model User {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  name          String
  email         String   @unique
  password      String
  uniqueId      String   @default("") // Employee ID or general identifier
  studentNumber String? // Regex pattern: /^\d{2}-\d{3}$/ (e.g., "24-101")
  role          String   @default("STUDENT") // Roles: "STUDENT", "PROFESSOR" (alias: INSTRUCTOR), "ADMIN"
  isActive      Boolean  @default(true)
  permissions   String   @default("[]") // JSON array of permission strings
  instituteId   String
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())

  // â”€â”€ Profile fields â”€â”€
  avatarUrl   String? // URL to uploaded avatar image (null = initials fallback)
  bio         String  @default("") // Short biography / description
  phone       String  @default("") // Contact phone number
  department  String  @default("") // e.g. "Computer Science", "Business Administration"
  yearLevel   String  @default("") // For students: "1st Year", "2nd Year", etc.
  coverColor  String  @default("#1E88E5") // Profile page banner accent color (hex)
  preferences String  @default("{}") // JSON object storing notification/theme settings

  institute           Institute               @relation(fields: [instituteId], references: [id])
  sessions            Session[]
  notes               Note[]
  taskItems           TaskItem[]
  calendarEvents      CalendarEvent[]
  taughtCourses       Course[]                @relation("CourseInstructor")
  enrollments         Enrollment[]
  groupMemberships    StudentGroupMember[]
  announcements       Announcement[]
  sentComments        PrivateComment[]        @relation("CommentSender")
  receivedComments    PrivateComment[]        @relation("CommentRecipient")
  submissions         StudentSubmission[]
  dashboardLayouts    DashboardLayout[]
  auditLogsAsAdmin    AuditLog[]              @relation("AuditAdmin")
  auditLogsAsTarget   AuditLog[]              @relation("AuditTarget")
  passwordResetOtps   PasswordResetOtp[]
  // â”€â”€â”€ Interactive Activities relations (Sprint 0) â”€â”€â”€
  activityTemplates   ActivityTemplate[]      @relation("ActivityTemplateCreator")
  activitySubmissions ActivitySubmission[]    @relation("ActivitySubmissions")
  activitySessions    ActivitySession[]       @relation("ActivitySessions")
  gamificationProfile GamificationProfile?
  flashcardDecks      FlashcardDeck[]         @relation("FlashcardDeckCreator")
  flashcardProgresses FlashcardProgress[]     @relation("FlashcardProgressUser")
  studySessionLogs    StudySessionLog[]
  materialAnnotations MaterialAnnotation[]
  notifications       Notification[]
  sentBroadcasts      NotificationBroadcast[] @relation("BroadcastSender")
  expTransactions     ExpTransaction[]
  createdGradeIncentives GradeIncentiveRule[] @relation("GradeIncentiveCreator")
  integrityEvents     IntegrityEvent[]     @relation("StudentIntegrityEvents")

  // ─── Knowledge Exchange relations ───
  kxPosts               KxPost[]               @relation("KxPostAuthor")
  kxAnswers             KxAnswer[]             @relation("KxAnswerAuthor")
  kxVerifiedAnswers     KxAnswer[]             @relation("KxAnswerVerifier")
  kxComments            KxComment[]            @relation("KxCommentAuthor")
  kxVotes               KxVote[]               @relation("KxUserVotes")
  kxRevisions           KxRevision[]           @relation("KxRevisionEditor")
  kxReportedFlags       KxFlag[]               @relation("KxFlagReporter")
  kxReviewedFlags       KxFlag[]               @relation("KxFlagReviewer")
  kxBookmarks           KxBookmark[]           @relation("KxUserBookmarks")
  kxFollows             KxFollow[]             @relation("KxUserFollows")
  kxModerationActions   KxModerationAction[]   @relation("KxModeratorActions")
  kxNotifications       KxNotification[]       @relation("KxUserNotifications")

  // ─── GitHub Integration relations ───
  githubToken           GithubToken?
  githubRepoLinks       GithubRepoLink[]       @relation("UserGithubRepoLinks")
  githubSubmissions     GithubSubmission[]     @relation("UserGithubSubmissions")
  githubComments        GithubInlineComment[]  @relation("UserGithubInlineComments")
}

model Session {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  tokenHash String   @unique @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  userAgent String?
  ipAddress String?
  expiresAt DateTime
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([tokenHash])
}

model Course {
  id                String                     @id @default(cuid())
  code              String
  courseCode        String                     @unique @default("")
  title             String
  section           String                     @default("")
  subject           String                     @default("")
  room              String                     @default("")
  description       String                     @default("")
  coverImage        String                     @default("")
  instructorId      String?
  instituteId       String
  isArchived        Boolean                    @default(false)
  createdAt         DateTime                   @default(now())
  updatedAt         DateTime                   @default(now()) @updatedAt
  leaderboardCaches ActivityLeaderboardCache[]
  activityTemplates ActivityTemplate[]
  announcements     Announcement[]
  calendarEvents    CalendarEvent[]
  institute         Institute                  @relation(fields: [instituteId], references: [id])
  instructor        User?                      @relation("CourseInstructor", fields: [instructorId], references: [id])
  dashboardLayouts  DashboardLayout[]
  enrollments       Enrollment[]
  flashcardDecks    FlashcardDeck[]
  gradingPolicy     GradingPolicy?
  privateComments   PrivateComment[]
  studentGroups     StudentGroup[]
  studySessions     StudySessionLog[]
  syllabusItems     SyllabusItem[]
  taskItems         TaskItem[]
  weeklyChallenges  WeeklyChallenge[]
  broadcasts        NotificationBroadcast[]
  gradeIncentiveRules GradeIncentiveRule[]
  kxPosts             KxPost[]

  @@index([instituteId])
  @@index([instructorId])
}

model Enrollment {
  id                String   @id @default(cuid())
  courseId          String
  studentId         String
  status            String   @default("PENDING")
  displayOrderIndex Int      @default(0)
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now())
  course            Course   @relation(fields: [courseId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  student           User     @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([courseId, studentId])
  @@index([courseId, status])
  @@index([studentId])
}

model SyllabusItem {
  id            String                @id @default(cuid())
  courseId      String
  type          String                @default("MATERIAL")
  title         String
  description   String                @default("")
  dueDate       DateTime?
  maxPoints     Int?
  orderIndex    Int                   @default(0)
  createdAt     DateTime              @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime              @default(now()) @updatedAt
  attachments   Attachment[]
  submissions   StudentSubmission[]
  studySessions StudySessionLog[]
  enableIntegrityMonitoring Boolean               @default(false)
  requireFullscreen         Boolean               @default(false)
  integrityEvents           IntegrityEvent[]
  course        Course                @relation(fields: [courseId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  targetGroups  SyllabusTargetGroup[]
  kxPosts       KxPost[]
  githubSubmissions GithubSubmission[]

  @@index([courseId, type])
  @@index([courseId, orderIndex])
}

model StudentGroup {
  id            String                @id @default(cuid())
  courseId      String
  groupName     String
  createdAt     DateTime              @default(now())
  course        Course                @relation(fields: [courseId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  members       StudentGroupMember[]
  targetedItems SyllabusTargetGroup[]

  @@index([courseId])
}

model StudentGroupMember {
  id        String       @id @default(cuid())
  groupId   String
  studentId String
  group     StudentGroup @relation(fields: [groupId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  student   User         @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([groupId, studentId])
  @@index([studentId])
}

model SyllabusTargetGroup {
  id             String       @id @default(cuid())
  syllabusItemId String
  groupId        String
  group          StudentGroup @relation(fields: [groupId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  syllabusItem   SyllabusItem @relation(fields: [syllabusItemId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([syllabusItemId, groupId])
}

model Announcement {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  courseId  String
  authorId  String
  content   String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  author    User     @relation(fields: [authorId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  course    Course   @relation(fields: [courseId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([courseId, createdAt])
}

model Notification {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  type      String   @default("ANNOUNCEMENT") // "ANNOUNCEMENT" | "GRADE" | "CLASSWORK" | "REMINDER" | "ALERT" | "BROADCAST"
  title     String
  message   String
  link      String   @default("")
  isRead    Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, isRead])
  @@index([userId, createdAt])
}

model NotificationBroadcast {
  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  courseId       String
  senderId       String
  message        String
  category       String   @default("GENERAL") // "REMINDER" | "ALERT" | "GENERAL"
  scope          String   @default("ALL") // "ALL" or JSON array of student IDs
  recipientCount Int      @default(0)
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
  course         Course   @relation(fields: [courseId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  sender         User     @relation("BroadcastSender", fields: [senderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([courseId, createdAt])
  @@index([senderId])
}

model PrivateComment {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  courseId    String
  senderId    String
  recipientId String
  content     String
  sentiment   String?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  course      Course   @relation(fields: [courseId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  recipient   User     @relation("CommentRecipient", fields: [recipientId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  sender      User     @relation("CommentSender", fields: [senderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([courseId, recipientId])
  @@index([senderId])
}

model Attachment {
  id             String               @id @default(cuid())
  syllabusItemId String
  type           String               @default("FILE")
  url            String
  fileName       String               @default("")
  fileSize       Int?
  createdAt      DateTime             @default(now())
  syllabusItem   SyllabusItem         @relation(fields: [syllabusItemId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  annotations    MaterialAnnotation[]

  @@index([syllabusItemId])
}

model StudentSubmission {
  id             String                 @id @default(cuid())
  syllabusItemId String
  studentId      String
  status         String                 @default("DRAFT")
  grade          Float?
  isReturned     Boolean                @default(false)
  submittedAt    DateTime?
  createdAt      DateTime               @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime               @default(now()) @updatedAt
  student        User                   @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  syllabusItem   SyllabusItem           @relation(fields: [syllabusItemId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  attachments    SubmissionAttachment[]
  integrityEvents IntegrityEvent[]
  githubRepoLinks GithubRepoLink[]

  @@unique([syllabusItemId, studentId])
  @@index([syllabusItemId])
  @@index([studentId])
}

model SubmissionAttachment {
  id           String            @id @default(cuid())
  submissionId String
  type         String            @default("FILE")
  url          String
  fileName     String            @default("")
  createdAt    DateTime          @default(now())
  submission   StudentSubmission @relation(fields: [submissionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([submissionId])
}

model DashboardLayout {
  id                String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId            String
  courseId          String
  displayOrderIndex Int      @default(0)
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt         DateTime @default(now()) @updatedAt
  course            Course   @relation(fields: [courseId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user              User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, courseId])
  @@index([userId])
}

model Note {
  id          String    @id @default(cuid())
  title       String    @default("")
  content     String    @default("")
  category    String    @default("General")
  color       String    @default("#ffffff")
  pinned      Boolean   @default(false)
  archived    Boolean   @default(false)
  orderIndex  Int       @default(0)
  creatorId   String
  instituteId String
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt
  creator     User      @relation(fields: [creatorId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  institute   Institute @relation(fields: [instituteId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([instituteId, creatorId])
  @@index([instituteId, archived, pinned, orderIndex])

model TaskItem {
  id          String    @id @default(cuid())
  title       String
  description String    @default("")
  priority    String    @default("medium")
  dueDate     DateTime?
  courseId    String?
  completed   Boolean   @default(false)
  archived    Boolean   @default(false)
  orderIndex  Int       @default(0)
  creatorId   String
  instituteId String
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt
  course      Course?   @relation(fields: [courseId], references: [id])
  creator     User      @relation(fields: [creatorId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  institute   Institute @relation(fields: [instituteId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  description   String    @default("")

  templateId            String
  activityType          String

// ─── Quiz & Activity Anti-Cheating Integrity Monitoring ───
model IntegrityEvent {
  id             String             @id @default(cuid())

  syllabusItemId String
  submissionId   String?
  eventType      String             // "TAB_SWITCH" | "COPY_PASTE" | "FULLSCREEN_EXIT" | "RIGHT_CLICK"

// ─── Knowledge Exchange (KX) Q&A Models (ICS Exclusive) ──────
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  title          String
  body           String
  postType       String                @default("QUESTION") // "QUESTION" | "DISCUSSION"
  status         String                @default("OPEN")     // "OPEN" | "ANSWERED" | "CLOSED" | "LOCKED"
  isAnonymous    Boolean               @default(false)
  authorId       String
  instituteId    String
  courseId       String?
  syllabusItemId String?
  viewCount      Int                   @default(0)
  voteCount      Int                   @default(0)
  answerCount    Int                   @default(0)

  createdAt      DateTime              @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime              @updatedAt

  @@index([syllabusItemId])

# Preflight verification contract, not feature implementation approval

These fixtures are a proposed verification interface for the human's twelve criteria. The later requirements/recon/red-team/architecture adjudication must accept or explicitly revise the endpoint/DTO/UI/audit contract before authoritative planning. Any revision requires fresh independent fixture review and a new exact-source preflight receipt. No fixture approval means that the feature exists, product tests pass or HIGH implementation is approved.

HTTP GET interfaces: `/api/academic-oversight/{ics|ibe|ite}/courses` and `/api/academic-oversight/{institute}/courses/{courseId}`. The read-only page is `/{institute}/academic-operations/courses/{courseId}/supervision`; its course-only region has `data-testid="course-supervision-readonly"`. Exact response shapes are enforced by fixture.ts. Course metadata, assigned instructor id/name, course-linked calendar summaries, announcements and syllabus/material summaries are allowed. Student objects/identities, grades, submissions, attempts, answers, execution details and additional fields are not allowed.

Program scope is grounded in the existing repository. There is no Program model. `src/lib/activity-eligibility.ts` explicitly uses ICS as the current BSIT/BSCpE eligibility boundary. The tests therefore reject caller-supplied program/institute claims on the real activity endpoint and verify request claims cannot alter selected-institute route scope. They do not invent program tables, memberships or a new permission model.

Real HTTP mutation contracts: POST/PATCH/DELETE `/api/workspace/events` (courseId/id/title/eventDate); POST `/api/courses/{id}/submissions/grade` (submissionId/grade); PATCH `/api/courses/{id}/enrollments` (enrollmentId/action); POST `/api/activities/submit` (the actual shared schema); PATCH `/api/admin/users/{id}/status` (isActive) and `/role` (newRole/adminPassword).
